product_question: What does NYC's official definition-compatible Category 9 publication prove, and does it establish compliance with a performance minimum?

official_finding.definition: Percentage of response time of less than 10 minutes to Advanced Life Support medical emergencies by Advanced Life Support ambulances.

taxlane_assessment.reason: The official model establishes Category 9 publication at its own definition and grain. Section 15-129 mandates reporting but supplies no minimum acceptable share, and this review did not audit every community-district or division reporting grain. No pass/fail or fiscal bridge follows.

next_evidence.reporting_completeness: Test community-district and division publication against every Section 15-129 reporting grain.
next_evidence.outcomes: Join privacy-safe patient outcomes and population exposure at a compatible definition and time basis.
next_evidence.operations: Test demand, call processing, staffing, fleet, posting, routing, and hospital-interface drivers without treating borough variation as causal.
next_evidence.candidate: Only then bound one intervention with effect, cost, incidence, delivery, and do-no-harm evidence.

deferred_claims: exact under-ten-minute numerator and dispatch comparison
patient outcomes, causality, inequity, and adequacy
candidate effect, delivery, and net federal savings

public_warning: NYC's official calendar-2025 Category 9 publication is 39.26% across 216,599 qualifying incidents. This is definition-compatible threshold attainment, but Section 15-129 sets no minimum acceptable share and this review did not audit every statutory reporting grain. No legal or service pass/fail, exact numerator, causal, adequacy, fiscal, allocation, or rate claim follows.
